heading: **15 November 2025**
body:
1. *Prepare HT-SELEX Buffers, Plates & Programs*  
2. *Prepare 2 SBP Bead Plates, 4 His bead plates & Block and store more HIS beads*

| SELEX Buffer (prepare freshly) |  |  |  |  |  |
| ----- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reagents | STOCK | Final 1x: | 250 mL | Final 1.55x: | 70mL |
| Promega | 10x | 1x | 25 mL | 1.55x | 10.85 mL |
| EGTA | 0.5M | 100μM | 32 μL | 155μM | 21.7 μL |
| DTT | 1M | 1mM | 160 μL | 1.55mM | 108.5 μL |
| dIdC | 250μg/mL | 8.33μg/mL | 5331.2 μL | 8.33μg/mL | 2332.4 μL |
| ZnSO4 | 3mM | 3μM | 160 μL | 3μM | 70 μL |
| MQ water |   | \- | 138.3168 mL | \- | 56.6174 mL |

Manually distribute to a (800μL) deep-well 96 → distribute to four 96-well plates → freeze at \-20℃.  
Beads plate: add 20μL/well 1x SELEX buffer after the blocking buffer is aspirated;
